title: Query-instruction ablation
finding: `improve-rag-input-quality-5` task 5.3. Raw vs instructed queries interleaved on the frozen exp 22 index (instruction excluded from index identity, task 4.8). Paired R@5 lift **−0.0246** against a frozen +0.0300; identifier-heavy R@10 0.2563 < 0.2583. Latency gate failed for BOTH arms on a slow provider day — the raw arm was the slower at p95 5,543 ms vs 3,543 ms — so it did not discriminate and carries no evidence against the instruction. Raw arm reproduced exp 22's R@5 to six decimals, pinning the delta on the instruction. `EMBEDDING__QUERY_INSTRUCTION` stays empty; text NOT retuned
